frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Alright Diode, let's find those Fuseon Sentinels and get that Rhythm Core.

frames.heading: Diode
frames.body: ACTIVATING LOCATOR CHIP. FOLLOW ME, SPECIMEN.

frames.heading: Fuseon Sentinel
frames.body: HALT! WHO DARES APPROACH THE DOMAIN OF THE FUSEONS?

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Hello! I'm a traveller seeking the Rhythm Core to restore harmony to Electronova.

frames.heading: Fuseon Sentinel
frames.body: HA! RESTORE HARMONY? YOU MUST BE DELUSIONAL. WE ARE AT WAR WITH THE DIODES. THE GRAND COMPOSER HAS GIVEN US NEW PURPOSE. WE WILL NOT RELINQUISH THE RHYTHM CORE.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: War? But your world is silent and dying. Don't you miss the music, the energy, the life?

frames.heading: Fuseon Sentinel
frames.body: WE HAVE A NEW MASTER NOW. THE GRAND COMPOSER'S WILL IS ABSOLUTE. SILENCE IS OUR NEW SONG.

frames.heading: Diode
frames.body: FUSEON, REMEMBER WHO WE ARE. WE WERE ONCE ONE WITH THE BEAT, CREATORS OF RHYTHM AND SOUND. DO NOT LET THE GRAND COMPOSER'S INTERFERENCE DECEIVE YOU.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Listen, Fuseon. I can feel the beat within you, buried but not gone. Let me show you the power of groove, the spirit of Electronova. If you feel nothing, we'll leave in peace.

frames.heading: Fuseon Sentinel
frames.body: YOU SPEAK BOLDLY, TRAVELLER. BUT WORDS ALONE WILL NOT SWAY ME.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Then let's not speak. Let's groove!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Player, another new beat has appeared on the system!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: This one's funky. The RANDOM BEAT mixes it up for a while, throwing random gestures. It stabilises at the last moment!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Keep your eyes sharp, Player. Watch out for those random beats!
